failures.finding: Explicit TimeSpan.Zero was rejected by command descriptors.
failures.disposition: Fixed: retained as finite expiration before dispatch for Create and Parameterized. Negative values and nanosecond overflow still reject.

failures.finding: Rust JSON validation narrowed large RFC8259 numbers through f64 and admitted a 65th empty container.
failures.disposition: Fixed with serde_json borrowed RawValue syntax validation, strict UTF8/BOM/size guard and string-aware depth limit. Large exponents, reserved-looking object keys and depth64/65 are tested.

failures.finding: Relation parent-key kind4 admitted more than one row.
failures.disposition: Fixed: consumer-specific exact_rows/ExactRows is separate from payload kind. Both encode and parse reject two parent-key rows; generic multirow mutation and generated-only zero-descriptor insert remain admitted.

failures.finding: Ordinary projection parser had no scalar-only empty-alias context.
failures.disposition: Fixed: explicit scalar context, exact single field, codec/nullability retained; public ordinary aliases remain nonempty.

failures.finding: Nullable ReadOnlyMemory ternary converted SQL NULL to empty memory through implicit conversion.
failures.disposition: Fixed explicit null branch/cast, retained separate SQL NULL and empty-cell regression.

failures.finding: An initial network restore attempted cloud metadata access and automatic approval rejected the tool action.
failures.disposition: No retry of metadata access. All subsequent restores use local-only NuGet configuration, pinned cached packs, NuGetAudit=false for this offline run and --no-restore thereafter. Vulnerability audit is recorded unavailable offline.
failures.proof: Offline run NuGet.offline.config, offline-packs.json and commands.json; original rejection is a conversation tool event, not fabricated as a local log.

failures.finding: Rust1.100 clippy requires as_chunks for constant-width u32 vectors.
failures.disposition: Fixed without lint suppression; strict lint pass retained.

failures.finding: Constant chunk helper fix required multiline rustfmt formatting.
failures.disposition: Applied rustfmt and retained later strict format success.

failures.finding: Unfiltered cargo metadata tried to inspect uncached libc for other target architectures.
failures.disposition: Filter inventory to x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu for this Linux-only acceptance. All actual built dependency versions and licenses are retained.

failures.finding: AOT execution lacked an explicit dynamic-code assertion and actual selected-linker identity.
failures.disposition: Added --require-aot to both executed binaries and recorded actual Rust link invocation, AOT MSBuild linker selection, versions and SHA-256 hashes. Independent review closed this finding.

failures.finding: The first split-lock condition recognized RuntimeIdentifier but dotnet restore -r supplies RuntimeIdentifiers, producing NU1004 under locked mode.
failures.disposition: The two task-owned project conditions now support restore and publish RID property names. Both ordinary and Linux AOT locked restores succeeded with unchanged lock bytes.
failures.proof: split-lock-commands.json and split-lock-aot.log; first failure remains a conversation tool event, not fabricated as a local log.
